content: To achieve the best results, take this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals as directed by your doctor. Continue taking the medication for the full prescribed duration, even if your symptoms improve after a few days. Stopping the medication early may allow the infection to return. Common side effects of this medication may include abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting. However, remember that your doctor has prescribed this medication because they believe the benefits outweigh the potential risks. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare, but they can occur. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. Before taking vancomycin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is not known whether this form of vancomycin passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. Do not use it for other infections unless directed by your doctor. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as stool samples or kidney function tests, may be required while you are taking this medication to monitor your progress and check for side effects. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication in the refrigerator, away from light and moisture. Do not freeze it. Discard any unused medication after 14 days. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
